### Cheap reading + strong re-reading of doubtful lines

Line-level: the cheap reading is kept except on lines where a second cheap reading differs on more than 10 % of the letters; the strong model gets the image and the draft and writes only those lines. Page-level: the strong model's whole reading replaces the cheap one when the two cheap readings differ on more than the threshold of the page's letters. Cost = all calls made.
